title: UNTOLD
GRANTH
tagline: Stories from Valmiki you were never told.
cta_hi: ऐसी और अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, फ़ॉलो करें।

check_against: wisdomlib.org Shastri translation (vulgate numbering = CE + ~2 in Aranya)

language.narration: Hindi (Devanagari) — the only Hindi; everything written is English

major_characters.rule: User picks the voice (audition with options) ONLY for major, recurring characters. Minor / one-episode characters: Claude auditions 3-5 openly-licensed candidates, picks the best by fit + pronunciation, locks it, and notes it in cast.json.

cta._note: Per-platform call to action: end-card button + the narrator's closing line. Instagram/Facebook = follow, YouTube = subscribe. The CTA shot is marked "cta": true in script.json; its YouTube line is generated as extra takes s<ID>y_*.

instagram.say: ऐसी और अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, फ़ॉलो करें।

youtube.say: ऐसी और अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, सब्सक्राइब करें।

address.rule: Characters never call Rama by his bare name unless they are his elders, gurus, sages or adversaries. Narration may say 'राम'.

forms.hanuman: प्रभु / प्रभु श्रीराम; Sita = माता सीता

hanuman_child.look: a little human boy: human face (eyebrows, nose, lips, no muzzle), black hair with a gold-banded top-knot, red tilak, golden-brown skin, gold necklace and bangles, red dhoti with gold border; vanara signs only: small rounded monkey ears and the tail
hanuman_child.rule: Show the user any new or changed look for a major character as stills BEFORE rendering.

jambavan.approved_by: claude (owner asked Claude to choose, Nov 21 2026: 'it should not look like an insult')
jambavan.look: aged king of the bears, son of Prajapati (CE 6.61.14): silvered grey fur, small round ears, long pale snout, heavy white brows, flowing white beard, gold head band with a red jewel, deep red dhoti, serious calm face; no tail
jambavan.rule: Keep him dignified: never cute or comic. Show the owner any change as stills first.

janaka.look: royal sage (rajarshi): white hair and beard, gold crown with red jewel, ivory dhoti, gold sash, red garland beads
janaka.rule: Show the user any change as stills first.

parashurama.look: warrior-sage: black jata and beard, bark-brown robe, rudraksha, axe in hand, bow and quiver
parashurama.rule: Show the user any change as stills first.

narration_energy.question: Does a livelier narrator on the hook and the reveal get more views than the calm narrator?
narration_energy.test_reels: the NEXT 2 reels made (plan order: A17 Urmila, A82 Shanta)
narration_energy.how: script.json "narration_energy": "hook_reveal"; energetic tags ([excited] [dramatically] [intense]) ONLY on shot 1 (hook) and shots marked "reveal": true; everything else calm; the opening śloka as usual; the shouting guard stays on
narration_energy.compare_with: calm reels of similar fame: A23 (Sanjeevani), A18 (swayamvara), A89 (baby Hanuman)
narration_energy.measure: YouTube views and Instagram views/reach at 48 h after posting (Dashboard → Refresh stats); Instagram views need the instagram_manage_insights permission
narration_energy.decide: after both test reels reach 48 h: keep calm, adopt hook/reveal energy, or test more
